channel.title: Business Advantage PNG - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Advantage PNG (businessadvantagepng.com)

item.title: Key milestones checked off at Papua New Guinea’s first lime and cement project - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Pacific Lime and Cement ended 2025 with a flurry of announcements, including agreements with the PNG Government and International Finance Corporation. PLC Managing Director Paul Mulder tells Business Advantage PNG why these agreements are so important to the success of its Central Cement and Lime Project.

item.title: Port Moresby hotels spend big ahead of anticipated visitor influx - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Arrivals into Port Moresby are expected to grow substantially in coming years. Business Advantage PNG provides a roundup of the big investments being made by PNG’s hotel operators in anticipation of this growth.

item.title: Papua New Guinea's orchids on show in new garden - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Mary Tao looks at the new exhibit at the Port Moresby Nature Park featuring a collection of Papua New Guinea's stunning local orchids.

item.title: Special Economic Zones move from concept to reality - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: The creation of Special Economic Zones is one of the PNG Government’s key strategies for encouraging economic growth. We talk to the acting head of PNG’s Special Economic Zones Authority to understand the opportunity SEZs represent to investors.

item.title: People Moves: Bougainville Copper Limited, PNG Forest Products, Tropic Air, Nasfund - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: New chairman for BCL, new managing director for PNG Forest Products and Tropicair, addition to Nasfund's executive management team.

item.title: Restaurant Review: Sidaam, Port Moresby - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Andrew Wilkins visits the recently opened sister to Kuro Haus, flavour-filled Thai restaurant and bar Sidaam.

item.title: What does the 2026 PNG 100 CEO Survey tell us? - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: This year’s Business Advantage PNG/Westpac PNG 100 CEO Survey reveals positive business sentiment, continuing the momentum from last year.

item.title: The 2026 PNG 100 CEO Survey: the results - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: Since 2012, the data collected by the PNG 100 CEO Survey has revealed trends in business confidence among business leaders. So, how confident are Papua New Guinea's leading businesses about 2026?

item.title: 'We've opened accounts in all 22 provinces': CreditBank PNG CEO on what's driving his bank's rise - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: CreditBank PNG has experienced rapid growth since receiving a Papua New Guinea banking licence in 2024. In this interview with Business Advantage PNG, its CEO Danny Robinson shares the key drivers behind this success, reveals what’s next and provides his outlook for the banking sector as a whole.

item.title: Investors stepping up to guarantee Papua New Guinea's fuel security - Business Advantage PNG
item.description: PNG’s recent challenges with fuel supply are leading to the creation of a more robust supply chain, thanks to new investments and partnerships involving state-owned entities, the private sector and even the US government. Business Advantage PNG takes a closer look.
